verdict.rationale: Render documents built-in metrics for its own infrastructure and the ability to stream telemetry to external tools. Neither of these is a documented capability to build custom dashboards that combine metrics from any service. Building such dashboards in an external tool is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can build custom dashboards combining metrics from any service

citations.quote: See critical metrics for all of your Render infrastructure from day zero, and stream telemetry to external tools.
